supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:58 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 had a roughly 9-second HTTP connection to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 with 51,000,389 client-originated bytes. This supports that a large amount of data was sent from the workstation to the proxy, but does not identify the external destination or establish that an upload succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-ICHEN-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so process and endpoint activity at the time of the transfer cannot be attributed.
Proxy collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so proxy request details that could identify the destination, URL, method, or result are missing.
Zeek connection evidence records the workstation-to-proxy flow but does not show the transferred content or the external endpoint.
claims_not_established: The external destination, request details, and whether the transfer reached an external service.
What data was transferred, whether it contained sensitive information, and whether the transfer was authorized.
Which process initiated the connection and whether it was associated with user activity or an approved application.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy access and tunnel logs for 13:45:58 UTC, including destination, request method, URL or host, and transfer result.
Obtain endpoint or EDR process/network telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 at the transfer time.
Identify files accessed or staged near the transfer and confirm with the user or relevant business owner whether the transfer was expected.
unrelated_findings: After the alerted transfer, ivy.chen's browser accessed aws.amazon.com and the AWS console at 14:12–14:13 UTC. The available records do not establish a connection to the 13:45 transfer; assess separately if needed (T039-00266, T039-00286).
